clip49.title: Pyaaz kaatne par aansu kyun aate hain? Asli wajah #Shorts
clip49.description:
Pyaaz kaatte hi aansu kyun? Kat-te hi ek enzyme (lachrymatory-factor synthase) nikalta hai jo pyaaz ke amino acid sulfoxides ko sulfenic acid mein badalta hai. Ye acid badal kar syn-propanethial-S-oxide banta hai, jo hawa se aankhon tak pahunchta hai aur aansu wali (lachrymal) glands ko irritate karta hai. Pehle scientists enzyme alliinase ko dosh dete the; asli enzyme 2002 ki research (Imai et al.) mein mila.

Source:
- Library of Congress, Everyday Mysteries, "Why does chopping an onion make you cry?": https://www.loc.gov/everyday-mysteries/food-and-nutrition/item/why-does-chopping-an-onion-make-you-cry/ (read 28 Nov 2026)

clip51.title: Phone kho gaya ya chori ho gaya? Turant ye karo (Sanchar Saathi) #Shorts
clip51.description:
Phone kho gaya ya chori ho gaya? CEIR user manual ke hisaab se: 1) police complaint karo (FIR/LR) aur copy rakho. 2) Telecom company se usi number ka naya SIM lo, OTP usi pe aata hai. 3) Sanchar Saathi portal pe "Block lost / stolen mobile handset" form bharo (complaint copy, ID proof; purchase invoice optional), OTP verify karo. Block hone par device sabhi service provider networks pe block hota hai, aur details tracing ke liye police ke saath share hoti hain. 18-digit Request ID milti hai: isse status check aur phone milne par "Unblock found mobile handset" se unblock karte hain. General jaankari, legal advice nahi.

Sources:
- Sanchar Saathi, CEIR services (Govt of India, DoT): https://sancharsaathi.gov.in/Home/ceir-services.jsp (read 28 Nov 2026)
- CEIR Mobile User Manual (English v02): https://ceir.sancharsaathi.gov.in/HelpDocuments/English/CEIR_Mobile_User_Manual_English_v02.pdf (read 28 Nov 2026)

clip52.title: Bijli kitni door giri? Seconds gin ke pata karo #Shorts
clip52.description:
Bijli ki chamak turant dikhti hai, par garaj ki awaaz ko 1 mile chalne mein lagbhag 5 second lagte hain. Chamak aur garaj ke beech ke second gino aur 3 se divide karo: doori km mein (NOAA). Jaise 15 second = lagbhag 5 km. Ginti safe jagah par rehkar karo. Garaj sunai de toh aap bijli ki pahunch mein ho sakte ho: "When thunder roars, go indoors", aur aakhri garaj ke 30 minute baad tak andar raho; baarish rukne se bahar mat niklo.

Sources:
- NOAA JetStream, Lightning safety: https://www.noaa.gov/jetstream/lightning-safety (read 28 Nov 2026)
- US National Weather Service, Understanding Lightning: Thunder: https://www.weather.gov/safety/lightning-science-thunder (read 28 Nov 2026)
